document.cue: Describe a sport or physical activity that you enjoy doing.

text: I'd like to talk about swimming, which is my favourite sport. I started to swim when I was eight years old, because my parents wanted me to be strong and healthy. Now I go to the swimming pool two times a week, usually on Tuesday and Saturday.

The pool is in a sports centre near my university, so it's easy to get there after classes. It's a big pool with clean water, and there are also saunas, which I use sometimes. I usually go with my friend Dana. We swim for about forty minutes and then we have a hot drink and talk. At the beginning, my coach showed me different styles, for example freestyle and backstroke. Now I can swim quite fast, and last year I even took part in a small competition at my university. I didn't win, but I was happy to try. I also like the water because I don't feel tired when I swim, even if I do it for a long time.

I enjoy swimming for several reasons. First, it is good for my body, because I use all my muscles and my back doesn't hurt after sitting at the computer. Second, it helps me relax. When I am in the water, I don't think about exams or problems, and I feel calm after that. Also, it's a sport that you can do at any age, so I'm sure I will continue to swim in the future. I would recommend it to everybody who wants to stay in good shape.

tips.en: First and Second give the explanation a clear structure.
tips.kk: First және Second түсіндіруді құрылымды етеді.
tips.ru: First и Second делают объяснение структурным.
tips.example: First, it is good for my body

tips.en: Quite softens a claim and sounds natural.
tips.ru: Quite смягчает утверждение и звучит естественно.
tips.example: Now I can swim quite fast

note.en: Names the sport, when it started and how often.
note.kk: Спорт түрін, қашан бастағанын және қаншалықты жиі айналысатынын атайды.
note.ru: Называет вид спорта, когда начал и как часто занимается.

note.en: Describes the place, company, routine and a personal experience (a competition).
note.kk: Орынды, серікті, үдерісті және жеке тәжірибені (жарыс) сипаттайды.
note.ru: Описывает место, компанию, процесс и личный опыт (соревнование).

note.en: Explains why: body benefits, relaxation, any age.
note.kk: Неге ұнайтынын түсіндіреді: денеге пайдасы, демалу, жас.
note.ru: Объясняет, почему нравится: польза для тела, расслабление, возраст.
